# Thunderstorm audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/thunderstorm-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set thunderstorm` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `storm.mp3` is cut from "Rain and Thunder #2" by Joseph SARDIN, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://bigsoundbank.com/rain-and-storm-2-s0740.html.
- `sea.mp3` is cut from "Rough Baltic Sea" by GirlWithSoundRecorder, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/GirlWithSoundRecorder/sounds/441008/.
